storage: Keep in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place; in monsoon, refrigerate to avoid weevils and rancid smell.
looksLike: A fine, silky, pale-yellow flour ground from split, skinned chana dal (Bengal gram), with a mild nutty, raw-bean smell.
howToPick: Check a fresh packing date, a uniform pale yellow colour and a clean, nutty smell. Avoid a sour or musty smell, lumps or clumps, or a whitish colour that may hint at wheat flour.
shelfLife: About 3 to 6 months in sealed packs (pack label governs; general guidance, not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Moong dal flour (or soaked, ground moong dal)
Chickpea flour made at home from roasted chana dal

usedIn.raw: 50 g besan per serving (a scant ½ cup)
30 g besan per serving (about ¼ cup, for the vada batter)
